title: Recovering an object as the derived limit of its truncations under a vanishing hypothesis
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that an object whose cohomology sheaves satisfy a suitable vanishing condition over a covering family is recovered as the derived limit of its truncations (statement lines 5416-5430). The proof identifies the hypothesis of the statement with the hypothesis of the companion criterion of the same chapter (proof lines 5432-5435) and applies it (proof lines 5435-5437). The content is the matching of the two hypotheses, which is why the proof is short. The claim is H2: one application of a companion criterion.
